Daily Devotional

October 2

6 But godliness with contentment is great gain. 7 For we brought nothing into this world, and it is certain we can carry nothing out. 8 And having food and raiment let us be therewith content. (1 Timothy 6:6-8 KJV)

Paul is telling us to be happy with what we have and our lot in life. Jesus said that life does not consist of the abundance of the things we have (Luke 12:15), and we should not think that our happiness is tied to things that we have or want. As this verse says, “godliness with contentment is great gain”, as leading a Godly life, and being content with our life, is a treasure to be desired. So many people go through life wanting and getting things, but never finding satisfaction in them. Life is so much more than the possessions that we obtain, and it would pay us all to send things on ahead of us to heaven, as we can’t take anything with us when we go there (Matthew 6:20).

This verse is not saying that we should just stay poor, and only have food and clothes, as our Lord wants us to prosper (3 John 1:2). We should be content with what we have and seek the Lord with all our hearts, and He will provide for our needs (Matthew 6:33). The mistake that so many people make, is believing that things are what will make us happy. Contentment does not come from possessions, but from God’s love in our hearts. If you have ever experienced the peace and love of God, you will know that nothing in this world can compare to that. Thank you Lord, for giving us the fruit of the spirit (Galatians 5:22-23) when we are born again.
